status: Partial offline geometry domains, not a complete robot joint-limit set
geometry_basis: V9 collision_meshes.npz only; NOT V10/V11 wiring or V12/V13 full assembly
limitations: A positive result covers four spread coordinates simultaneously around one fixed posture only.
All flexion, thumb and arm coordinates and their uncertainties must match the evidence domain exactly.
Camera uncertainty must be added to tracking error; no measured error envelope is supplied.
Do not interpolate between accepted endpoints and assume the path is approved.
No result from this tool authorizes movement or fabrication.
